info.name: UVeye Public API v1 Media API

params.name: key
params.description: The image key, taken from an image URL returned by another endpoint.

items.docs: Returns an image acquired during a UVeye inspection, identified by a `key` query parameter. You normally do not build this request yourself - image URLs returned inside other endpoints' responses (overviewImage, coverImage, tire treadImage/wallImage, detection image/croppedImage, Atlas coverImages/animatedFrames) already include the `?key=` parameter; use the returned URL as-is. Image URLs are valid for 1 hour unless stated otherwise.
